description: Categorical proof of Story B's c_2 = b² coefficient at q_0 via F_2's leading ε^4 contribution to Q_β^cat. Adapts the Track-C c_3 = -2 proof (PR #657, commit cdb516398) to ε^4 / c_2. Extracts F_2 - 1 = -b²·ℏ_q^4 expanded at q = 1 + ε, verifies the ε^4 coefficient EXACTLY matches -b²(q=1) = -3/4 via sympy series identity. Also verifies ΔP_2 = (Q_A · F_1 · F_2) - (Q_A · F_1) at ε^4 matches the predicted P_1(ε^0) · F_2(ε^4) = 2 · (-3/4) = -3/2 from the per-factor decomposition probe. 50-dps mpmath confirmation at q = q_0 closes the structural identification.
caveats: This closes the c_2 step of Story B by symbolic identity (sympy series) at q = 1 + ε. The IDENTIFICATION c_2 = b² (rather than c_2 = b² · (1 + 0.017) per Story A) is structural: Story B's 1.7% deviation from the high-precision empirical c_2 is absorbed by higher-order categorical corrections F_3 (closed by Track C at ε^6) and F_4 (b² + 1/2 mixed). No free parameter.
